PURBASHA GRAMIN BANK
(A fictional bank) · Sonarpur Branch

Date: 11th October 2026

To,
Anjali Tirkey
210, Kali Mandir Lane, Sonarpur, West Bengal - 700150

Sub: Reminder for overdue instalments in Loan Account No. 112200508490

Dear Customer,

This is to inform you that 2 EMI(s) of ₹ 12,450.00 each in your above loan account are overdue since 11th August 2026. The total overdue amount is ₹ 24,900.00, and penal interest of ₹ 996.00 has been levied as per the sanction terms.

You are requested to pay ₹ 25,896.00 on or before 26th October 2026 to regularise the account.

Please note that if the dues are not cleared, the account will be classified as a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) on 9th November 2026, which will affect your credit score, and the Bank may initiate recovery proceedings as per law.

If you have already paid, please ignore this letter.

Yours faithfully,
Branch Manager
